issue.title: Is there any way to read and rewrite the request body in a middleware?

system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant who classifies GitHub issues according to predefined categories. Your goal is to determine if the GitHub issue can be reproduced to verify the provided solution's correctness.
llm_response:
I'll analyze this GitHub issue to determine if it requires a build environment to verify the solution.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about middleware functionality in ASP.NET Core, specifically how to properly read and rewrite the request body. The problem can be analyzed without needing to build and run the code. The issue is that after reading the request body in the middleware, the position of the stream is at the end, and when writing new content, it's appending rather than replacing. Additionally, the stream isn't being reset to position 0 after writing, so when the controller tries to read it, it finds nothing.

The solution would involve properly resetting the stream position after reading and writing operations, like:
1. After reading the request body, reset the position: `req.Body.Position = 0;`
2. After writing to the request body, reset the position again: `req.Body.Position = 0;`

This is a common pattern issue in ASP.NET Core middleware that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build the application. The problem is clearly visible in the code snippet - the stream position management is incorrect, which is why the action parameter is always null (the controller can't read data from a stream positioned at the end).
